question: Among all carbon atoms that are directly involved in a double bond, determine whether their parent molecules are more frequently carcinogenic ('+') or non-carcinogenic ('-').

prediction.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN '+' ELSE '-' END AS more_frequent
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007 OR a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008
JOIN bond b ON c.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'c' AND b.XCL_006 = '='
